file_id: Sk. Saidulla vs Unknown on 18 January, 2023

sentences.text: Sk. Saidulla vs Unknown on 18 January, 2023

Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak
18.01.2023

Serial no. 19 [Dd] (Anticipatory bail) Allowed) CRM (A) 224 of 2023 In re : An Application for Anticipatory Bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Baduria Police Station Case No. 827 of 2022 dated 10.12.2022 under Sections 498A/323/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Baduria Police Station Case No. 827 of 2022
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: -And- In the matter of : Sk. Saidulla ... ... Petitioner Mr. Ujjal Ray, Advocate ... ...

For the Petitioner Mr.
Anowar Hossain, Ms. Ratna Ghosh, Advocates ... ...
For the State Apparently, the petitioner is not related to either the victim or the husband of the victim.
In such circumstances, we are inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest the petitioner shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only), with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also be subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and on further condition that the petitioner shall report before the Investigating Officer as and when called for till the conclusion of the investigation and on further condition that the petitioner shall appear on every date before the jurisdictional Court on and from the date fixed for appearance of the accused and in default the jurisdictional Court will pass appropriate order to secure the presence of the petitioner in Court including cancelling the anticipatory bail granted without further reference to this Court.
Prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is allowed. CRM (A) 224 of 2023 is disposed of.
(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
